Device Name
Traxcess™ 7 Mini Guidewire
Indications for Use (Describe)
Traxcess™ 7 Mini Guidewire is indicated for general intravascular use, including the neuro and peripheral vasculature.
The guidewire can be steered to facilitate the selective placement of diagnostic or therapeutic catheters. This device is not
indicated for use in coronary arteries.
Type of Use (Select one or both, as applicable)
Prescription Use (Part 21 CFR 801 Subpart D) Over-The-Counter Use (21 CFR 801 Subpart C)
